title: Business Analyst / Systems Analyst
description:
Business Analyst / Systems Analyst

Join Sagoss, an award-winning technology business where great analysis directly shapes the software clients use. This hands-on opportunity suits an experienced analyst who enjoys solving problems, working closely with developers and turning complex requirements into clear solutions.

If you’ve also worked in the following roles, we’d also like to hear from you: Technical Business Analyst, Senior Business Analyst, Business Systems Analyst, Requirements Analyst, IT Business Analyst, Technical Analyst, Functional Analyst, Business Process Analyst

Benefits include onsite parking, onsite restaurant and onsite gym


SALARY: £38,000 to £45,000 per annum + Benefits

LOCATION: Henley-on-Thames, Oxfordshire (Office Based)

JOB TYPE: Full-Time, Permanent


JOB OVERVIEW

This is a chance to step into a visible, influential position where good analysis has an immediate impact on clients, developers and delivery.

The Business Analyst / Systems Analyst will take real ownership of customer requirements, shaping ideas into practical, buildable solutions and helping projects move forward with clarity and pace.

Working at the heart of a collaborative technology team, the Business Analyst / Systems Analyst will combine client engagement with hands-on technical analysis, JIRA, SQL and process improvement.

The Business Analyst / Systems Analyst will have the freedom to improve how requirements are managed and help shape stronger ways of working across the business.


ABOUT US

Established in 2006, Sagoss Group is a growing, entrepreneurial group made up of three distinctive businesses: Sagoss, Accellerate and Healthium Clinics. Each business operates in a specialist market, creating a varied and commercially interesting environment where finance plays an important role in supporting growth, control and future scalability.

Sagoss is a UK technology business delivering intelligent parking and transport solutions through an integrated platform that combines software, ANPR, payment systems, customer portals and connected hardware.

Accellerate is a medical market-access consultancy that helps healthcare technologies and products move successfully through market-access strategy, regulatory compliance, health economics and related commercial support.

Healthium Clinics is a private, CQC-registered medical and aesthetic clinic in Henley-on-Thames, offering private healthcare, wellness, skin and non-surgical services in a discreet, patient-focused setting.


DUTIES

Your duties as the Business Analyst / Systems Analyst include:

  • Requirements Gathering and Client Engagement: Lead client meetings and workshops, uncover business needs and explain supported, cost-effective solutions clearly
  • Analysis and Solution Design: Analyse requests against existing functionality, map processes and data flows, assess impact, risk and effort, and work with developers on practical solutions
  • Specifications and Change Requests: Write functional and technical specifications, user stories and acceptance criteria, and manage change requests from initial request through approval, build, testing and release
  • Technical Analysis: Read and understand code, database structures and logs sufficiently to discuss solutions and investigate issues, using SQL or similar tools to query and validate data
  • JIRA and Prioritisation: Maintain a complete, prioritised backlog, manage timelines across clients and projects, and report progress, risks and blockers
  • Testing, Release and Handover: Write test scenarios, support system and user acceptance testing, confirm delivered changes meet specification, and prepare release notes and handover information
  • Continuous Improvement: Improve templates, standards and processes, identify recurring client needs and share knowledge across the team
  • Client and Team Collaboration: Work closely with developers and internal teams, manage expectations professionally and support occasional travel to client sites


CANDIDATE REQUIREMENTS

ESSENTIAL

  • Previous Business Analyst experience in a software or IT-based business
  • Proven experience writing functional and technical specifications, user stories and change requests
  • Strong understanding of software development, code, databases and the software development lifecycle
  • Confident daily use of JIRA and experience of Agile ways of working
  • Working knowledge of SQL and relational databases
  • Strong client-facing communication, active listening, presentation and stakeholder management skills
  • Ability to explain technical concepts clearly to non-technical clients
  • Strong organisation with the ability to manage multiple clients, priorities and deadlines
  • High level of IT literacy, including Microsoft Word, Excel, PowerPoint and Visio or similar

DESIRABLE

  • Hands-on programming experience or a background in development, testing or technical support
  • Understanding of APIs, integrations and data formats such as REST, JSON and XML
  • Experience with SaaS or configurable platforms used by multiple clients
  • Experience in parking, transport, local authority or NHS environments
  • Business analysis certification such as BCS or IIBA, or a degree in computing or a related field


BENEFITS

Benefits include private medical insurance, birthday leave, onsite parking, onsite restaurant and onsite gym. Competitive salary, reviewed in line with performance and business needs


NO AGENCIES PLEASE


HOW TO APPLY

To be considered for this job vacancy, please submit your CV to our Recruitment Team who will review your details.
